title: Offset
description: Supernerd designed and animated the LED screen content for Offset's performance of "Hating On Me" on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. The screens carry a grand old room through the whole song, changing its light on the drops, breaking apart in the bridge and finishing on a waving flag, all timed to the track and delivered to the show for Notch playback.
